recommendation: Keep this source change as-is; no external repository work or additional related Jira decision is needed for this bounded correction.
issue_request: FHIR-38868 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Request-pattern correction for R5 asking that section 12.4.10.1 refer to Request.groupIdentifier rather than Request.requisitionId.
initial_application: Commit 8fa6462acf59fec6bf0cc211df42b92e0db0f150 applied the issue by changing the explicit Request.requisitionId token in source/request/request-spreadsheet-notes.xml to Request.groupIdentifier, but left nearby element-like requisitionId prose and a code-styled requisitionId reference in the same active section.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request as an active logical pattern, and source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml defines Request.groupIdentifier with requisition as a synonym/business context rather than as a separate element. FHIR Workflow minutes for 2022-11-21 record FHIR-38868 as Persuasive. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision or community rationale.
reconciliation: Updated source/request/request-spreadsheet-notes.xml to describe the compound-request option as a shared group identifier and to use groupIdentifier/group identifier for the remaining element-like references, while preserving requisition/prescription/form identifiers as the business concept represented by Request.groupIdentifier.
source_changes: source/request/request-spreadsheet-notes.xml: changed the Shared requisition id subsection/list item to Shared group identifier and replaced remaining requisitionId tokens in that subsection with groupIdentifier or group identifier.
